criteria.criterion: Given GIS is opened from the V4 launcher, then the GIS workspace loads with the map and controls visible.
steps_taken: Observed the authenticated V4 GIS workspace open.
Verified the GIS heading, map canvas, layer controls, map search field, reset control, map style control, and zoom controls were visible.
criteria.actual_result: GIS workspace and controls were visible.

criteria.criterion: Given an available coverage or network layer is enabled, then the selected layer becomes visible on the map.
steps_taken: Captured the GIS state before enabling a layer.
Selected Add layer for Network Information.
Observed Network Information (1) in the map layers control with the layer visible/enabled.
criteria.actual_result: Network Information became the selected visible map layer.

criteria.criterion: Given the zoom-in control is used, then the map visibly changes scale while remaining centred on the current area.
steps_taken: Captured the enabled-layer state before zooming.
Observed the scale change from 20 km to 10 km while the map remained centred on the London area.
criteria.actual_result: The map scale changed to 10 km and remained centred on the current area.

criteria.criterion: Given the reset map view control is used, then the map returns to its default view and GIS controls remain usable.
steps_taken: Captured the zoomed state before reset.
Selected Reset north and flatten map.
Observed the map after the reset action.
criteria.actual_result: GIS controls remained usable, but the map remained at the 10 km zoomed scale instead of returning to the initial 20 km default view.

criteria.criterion: Given another available map style is selected, then the map appearance changes and the style control remains available for further use.
steps_taken: Captured the reset state before opening map styles.
Observed the map appearance change to a dark style and the style options remained available.
criteria.actual_result: The map changed to the Dark style and the style control remained available.
